pages.text: Dwell within the End until the Void has watched you back. A second lid slides across the Maw's gaze, and the Endermen, once outraged by a stare, now meet it with indifference.
Yet the peace is fragile. The Enderman you wound remembers the insult, and will teleport to your throat all the same.
Deed (Advanced): remain within the End for a spell. The gift is lost on any who carry no Maw.
